name: Primates
blurb: Lemurs, monkeys and apes, humans included: grasping hands, forward-facing eyes and large brains for their size.

fossilMin.taxon: Altiatlasius koulchii (THR 141, MNHN Paris), the oldest euprimate
fossilMin.dating: Magnetostratigraphy: late or latest Thanetian; top of the Thanetian, 56.0 Ma
fossilMin.checked: Benton et al. 2015, full text (palaeo-electronica.org/content/pdfs/424.pdf), node 81 (Crown Primates)

softMax.basis: Early Paleocene plesiadapiforms but no definitive crown primates: base of the Paleocene, 66.04 ± 0.4 Ma
softMax.checked: Benton et al. 2015, full text (palaeo-electronica.org/content/pdfs/424.pdf), node 81 (Crown Primates)

clock.method: Bayesian relaxed molecular clock (MCMCTree), posterior mean and 95% HPD
